idea: Consume a real connected two-cycle quantum electric/Hubbard Hamiltonian on its recomputed charged spin-half state. Current/contact and both flux tensors then couple literally to full charged propagation and nonforward response; no singleplaquette or isolated-ring tensors grafted.
geometry: 6sites,7links,xy and xz plaquettes share x link; two independent chord integers. Tree fields solved from BE+rho=0; all actual E integer in this preparation. NOT singleplaquette link-dependent half-offset sector.
background: b_N=(1,1,0,0,0,0)+(N-2)delta_anchor, rho=n-b_N. Explicit static opposite anchor charge; bare reservoir cost supplied zero. Compact Uedge raises actual Eedge by1 and true CAR hop preserves Gauss.
initial: Charged Nup2,Ndown1 full H lowest eigenstate, Sz+.5; S² computed via actual CAR Splus action. State_id hashed from actual H/ground; same ground for G, Dflux, J/contact and scattering.
sources: Literal peer charged_source on matched origin(2,1), plus(3,1), minus(1,1); integer Wilson path anchor→site and actual opposite anchor charge. Each source validates actual target E against desired source E. Spin-up six-site G supplied; down G not claimed.
G: Full spin-up6x6: additions†[(z+E0+mu)I-Hplus]^-1 additions + transpose(removals†[(z-E0+mu)I+Hminus]^-1 removals), explicit mu=0; both complete H sectors retained. Stored raw removal E0-Eminus has denominator z-pole. No low eigenspace Lehmann truncation.
J: Each ACTUAL sparse CAR transfer entry split by changed origin spin bit XOR target/origin, including double occupied origins. Jedge,spin=-i(Tspin-Tspin†); Cedge,spin=-(Tspin+Tspin†), mixed spin/edge contact zero. Spin-summed supplier transfer is never copied twice as a spin vertex.
profile: Exact straight-link integral epsilon_p dot dx exp(iq.x), continuum transverse unit frame built per supplied external q; finite open graph has no translation-invariant on-shell momentum. Incoming/outgoing q and both pol profiles explicit; outgoing conjugated.
interaction: T_f,ab=<f|C_ab|g>+<f|Jout_a†[E0+omega-H+i eta]^-1 Jin_b|g>+<f|Jin_b[E0-omegaout-H+i eta]^-1 Jout_a†|g>, omegaout=omega-(Ef-E0). Full shifted sparse LU, four RHS; partial low selected receivers only, every intermediate full H.
D: D_twoflux from Hermitian sinFlux_xy=(Uface-Uface†)/2i and sinFlux_xz via literal fullq retarded_matrix on charged g,H. Full2x2 finite nonlinear graph response, NOT vector-potential/free photon or massless dispersion claim.
spin_and_frame: Charged reference fixed Sz+.5. Selected low final eigenspaces QR-orthonormalized only WITHIN degenerate energy blocks, never across different eigenvalues. Propagator/scattering intermediate frames are sparse LU of complete H and do not depend on those selected eigenvectors.
normalization: g,f norm1, integer Wilson/CAR unit source coefficients; source_equal_time tensor exported without cutoff-loss renormalization. Physical EM 2x2 tensor sums source/receiver spin indices. Squared tensor norms are finite response weights, not continuum cross sections or decay rates.
